data.one_liner: Provides a collection of customizable icon fonts for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: The package bundles many popular icon fonts (e.g., MaterialCommunityIcons, FontAwesome, Ionicons) and exposes them as Flutter IconData constants. You can use them directly in Icon widgets without additional setup.
use_when: You need a large set of ready‑made icons from multiple families
You want a simple, code‑only way to include icons without native assets
You prefer null‑safe, declarative usage in Flutter
avoid_when: App size is a critical concern and you only need a few icons
You require SVG or animated icons not covered by the bundled fonts
You need runtime loading of custom icon fonts
strengths: Covers many popular icon families in one package
Null‑safe and works on all Flutter platforms
Zero native configuration – just add the dependency
weaknesses: Increases app bundle size due to many fonts
Limited to the provided icon sets; no SVG support

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you only need FontAwesome icons, this smaller package reduces bundle size

alternatives.name: material_symbols_icons
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides the latest Google Material Symbols with fine‑grained styling

alternatives.name: lucide_icons_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a modern, open‑source icon set as an alternative to the bundled fonts
